features: Scoped graph build comparison and changed/suspect transition identification
Bounded AI-free targeted exploration with explicit configured safe controls
Atomic per-item validated navigation batch approval/rejection
Individual authoritative expectation endorsement, separate from immutable requirements
Rollback lineage, stale-status and overlapping later-approval protection
SQLite-backed Memory Center review, comparison, exploration and rollback UI
resolvedDevelopmentFailures: Initial learning behavior tests failed before implementation
Schema-version assertions updated for additive migration; future-schema sentinel moved to version 999
Rollback test corrected to assert pre-run rejection of unapproved paths

securityReview: No arbitrary AI code/SQL/shell execution introduced
M1 origin/action/authentication/role/tenant and budget enforcement reused
Batch operations validate every transition atomically with available scoped replay evidence
Expectations cannot enter navigation batch promotion or mutate approved requirements
Rollback refuses later overlapping approvals and never restores a changed/suspect edge
Viewer APIs retain bearer authentication, Host/Origin validation and same-origin JSON enforcement
Original SQLite migrations unchanged; raw artifacts and private workspace data excluded
knownLimitations: Graph differences compare bounded observations; missing observations are change candidates, not proof a feature was removed
Regression impact is conservative and uses stored graph dependencies, not semantic proof of coverage
Expectation endorsement records approval/provenance only; applying it requires explicit new story and plan revisions
Exploration remains deterministic term matching with user-declared safe controls; no autonomous business-rule learning
